author: Reilly Mahon
title: Former paramedic sentenced for stealing fentanyl - NewsBreak
text:
By Reilly Mahon Maren Ewertz No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
CARROLL COUNTY , Iowa ( KCAU ) — A former paramedic in Carroll County, Iowa, will be spending more than two years in federal prison for messing with the vitals of a pain medication.
Teresa Johnson , 53, of Manilla, Iowa, recently received a prison sentence for one count of tampering with a consumer product.
She must also serve two years of supervised release after her prison term.
Story continues below
She pled guilty as part of a plea agreement back in October, along with giving up her paramedic license.
Federal officials say that from late 2024 to February 2025, Johnson took fentanyl from the county’s ambulance service and replaced it with saline.
